title: Ka huakaʻi a me ka hoʻomaha
description: Ten short stories about travel and holidays in and beyond Hawaiʻi: a first train ride, a ranch in Waimea, a hula school on Kauaʻi, the Menehune fishpond, a car break-in at a lookout, a sailing canoe, ʻIolani Palace, a volunteer coffee farm, saving for Japan and a volleyball trip to California.

lessons.title: Ke kaʻaahi hou
lessons.summary: On a holiday morning, Leinaʻala takes her nine-year-old grandson Kaimiola on Honolulu's new train from Kapolei to Kalihi; they wait twenty minutes and ride about twenty kilometres.
lessons.text:
He lā hoʻomaha kēia, a ʻaʻohe kula. Noho ʻo Leinaʻala ma Kapolei me kāna moʻopuna, ʻo Kaimiola. He keikikāne ʻo Kaimiola, a he ʻeiwa ona makahiki. I kēia kakahiaka, e holo ana lāua ma ke kaʻaahi hou i Kalihi. Noho ke kaikaina o Leinaʻala ma laila. ʻAʻole ʻo Kaimiola i holo ma ke kaʻaahi ma mua.

I ka hola 7 o ke kakahiaka, ua hele lāua i ke kahua kaʻaahi. Ma laila, ua hāʻawi kekahi limahana i kekahi pihi liʻiliʻi iā Kaimiola. Aia ke kiʻi o ke kaʻaahi ma luna o ka pihi. Ua hoʻopaʻa ke keikikāne i ka pihi ma kona lole.

Ua nānā ʻo Leinaʻala i kekahi hōʻailona. Ua ʻōlelo ka hōʻailona: "E hōʻea mai ana ke kaʻaahi aʻe ma hope o iwakālua minuke." "Iwakālua minuke! Lōʻihi loa kēlā," wahi a Kaimiola. "E kali kāua ma ʻaneʻi," wahi a kona kupuna wahine. Ua noho lāua ma laila, a ua kali lāua.

Ma hope o iwakālua minuke, ua lohe lāua i ke kaʻaahi. Ua hōʻea mai ia, a ua wehe ʻia nā puka. "E wiki! E komo!" wahi a Leinaʻala. Ua wiki lāua i loko, a ua noho lāua ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka puka aniani. Ua ʻike ʻo Kaimiola i ke kai ma kekahi ʻaoʻao, a me nā mauna ma ka ʻaoʻao ʻē aʻe.

Ua nīnau ke keikikāne, "ʻEhia kilomika mai Kapolei a i Kalihi?" Ua pane ʻo Leinaʻala, "Ma kahi o iwakālua kilomika." "Iwakālua kilomika i loko o 30 minuke wale nō! Wikiwiki loa ke kaʻaahi," wahi a Kaimiola.

A laila, ua lohe lāua i kekahi leo: "ʻO Kalihi kēia." "E iho kāua ma ʻaneʻi," wahi a Leinaʻala. Ua wiki lāua i waho. Ma ka hale o kona kaikaina, ua hōʻike ʻo Kaimiola i kāna pihi, a ua haʻi ʻo ia no ke kaʻaahi.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka mea a ka limahana i hāʻawi ai iā Kaimiola?
Ua hāʻawi ka limahana i kekahi pihi liʻiliʻi iā ia.
Ua kali lāua i ke kaʻaahi no ʻehia minuke?
Ua kali lāua no iwakālua minuke.
ʻEhia kilomika mai Kapolei a i Kalihi?
Ma kahi o iwakālua kilomika.
He aha ka mea a lāua i lohe ai ma Kalihi?
Ua lohe lāua i kekahi leo: "ʻO Kalihi kēia."

lessons.title: Ka mahi pipi ma Waimea
lessons.summary: City girl Leilehua spends three summer days on a cattle ranch in Waimea, gets a cowboy hat, overcomes her fear of horses, watches the cowboys brand calves and climbs a hill.
lessons.text:
I ke kauwela, ua hele ʻo Leilehua me kona makuahine i ka mokupuni ʻo Hawaiʻi. Noho lāua ma Honolulu, a ʻaʻole ʻo Leilehua i noho ma ke kuaʻāina ma mua. Makemake ʻo ia e ʻike i ke kuaʻāina, a ua hele lāua i kekahi mahi pipi ma Waimea no ʻekolu lā.

He ʻāina pālahalaha ka hapanui o ka mahi, me nā puʻu ʻōmaʻomaʻo ma kahi mamao. Maloʻo ka ʻāina ma kekahi ʻaoʻao, no ka mea, ʻaʻole nui ka ua ma laila.

Ma ka mahi, ua hālāwai lāua me kekahi paniolo, ʻo Kauhi. He pāpale nui ko Kauhi. Ua hāʻawi ʻo ia i kekahi pāpale iā Leilehua. "ʻĀnō, he paniolo ʻoe!" wahi āna.

Ua hōʻike ʻo Kauhi i kekahi lio iā Leilehua. Ua makaʻu ke kaikamahine. "Nui loa ka lio! Makaʻu au," wahi āna. "Mai makaʻu," wahi a ka paniolo. "He lio mālie kēia." Ua noho ʻo Leilehua ma luna o ka lio, a ua huki ʻo Kauhi i ke kaula. ʻAʻole ʻo Leilehua i makaʻu hou.

I ka lā aʻe, ua ʻike lāua i ka hana a nā paniolo me nā pipi ʻōpio. Ua huki nā paniolo i nā pipi me nā kaula. A laila, ua kuni lākou i kēlā me kēia pipi me kekahi hao wela. Ua nīnau ʻo Leilehua, "No ke aha e kuni ai i nā pipi?" Ua pane ʻo Kauhi, "Aia ka hōʻailona o kēia mahi ma ka hao."

I ka lā hope, ua piʻi lāua me Kauhi i ka piko o kekahi puʻu. Mai ka piko, ua ʻike lāua i ka ʻāina pālahalaha, nā pipi, a me ke kai ma kahi mamao. "Nani ke kuaʻāina," wahi a Leilehua. Ua hoʻi ʻo ia i Honolulu me kona pāpale paniolo ma kona poʻo.

Nā nīnau:
No ke aha i hele ai ʻo Leilehua i Waimea?
No ka mea, makemake ʻo ia e ʻike i ke kuaʻāina.
Pehea ka ʻāina o ka mahi?
He ʻāina pālahalaha ka hapanui o ka mahi, a maloʻo kekahi ʻaoʻao.
He aha ka mea a nā paniolo i hana ai me ka hao wela?
Ua kuni lākou i nā pipi me ka hao wela.
Ua ʻike lāua i ke aha mai ka piko o ka puʻu?
Ua ʻike lāua i ka ʻāina pālahalaha, nā pipi, a me ke kai.

lessons.title: Ka hālau ma Kauaʻi
lessons.summary: Kahekili and his sister Kaʻiʻini dance in a Mānoa hula school that travels to a competition on Kauaʻi: they weave mats, learn a four-verse song, practise breathing and promise each other to dance as one.
lessons.text:
ʻO Leiʻohu ke kumu o kekahi hālau hula ma Mānoa. Hula ʻo Kahekili me kona kaikuahine, ʻo Kaʻiʻini, ma ka hālau. He 16 makahiki ʻo Kahekili, a he 14 makahiki kona kaikuahine. I kēia makahiki, e hele ana ka hālau i Kauaʻi no kekahi hoʻokūkū hula.

Ma mua o ka huakaʻi, ua ulana nā haumāna i nā moena mai nā lau hala. Ua ulana ʻo Kaʻiʻini i kekahi moena nani no ke kumu. Ua aʻo ʻo Kahekili i ka hoʻokani ʻana i ka ipu. He hua lāʻau maloʻo ka ipu, a nui kona leo.

Ua aʻo ka hālau i kekahi mele me ʻehā paukū. No kekahi mokupuni kēlā me kēia paukū: Hawaiʻi, Maui, Oʻahu a me Kauaʻi. "Pono kākou e lōkahi," wahi a ke kumu. "Hoʻokahi leo, hoʻokahi hula. ʻO ka lōkahi ka mea nui."

Ua aʻo pū ke kumu iā lākou i ka hanu ʻana. "E hanu i loko me ka mālie, a laila e hā i waho," wahi āna. "ʻO ka hā ke ola." Ua hanu nā haumāna, a ua hā lākou, he ʻumi manawa.

Ma ka pō ma mua o ka huakaʻi, ua pelu nā haumāna i ko lākou mau lole hula a me nā moena, a ua hoʻokomo lākou i loko o nā ukana. Ua pelu ʻo Kaʻiʻini i ka moena no ke kumu me ka mālama nui.

Ma Kauaʻi, ua hopohopo ʻo Kahekili. "Inā e hewa au me ka ipu?" wahi āna. Ua ʻōlelo kona kaikuahine, "Hoʻohiki au, e hula ana au me ka lōkahi. E hoʻohiki ʻoe e hoʻokani i ka ipu me ka lōkahi." Ua hoʻohiki ʻo Kahekili. Ua hula ka hālau, a ua hoʻokani ʻo ia i ka ipu me ka hewa ʻole. Ua lanakila ka hālau ma ka hoʻokūkū.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai ke kumu o ka hālau?
ʻO Leiʻohu ke kumu o ka hālau.
He aha ka mea a nā haumāna i ulana ai?
Ua ulana lākou i nā moena mai nā lau hala.
ʻEhia paukū o ka mele?
He ʻehā paukū o ka mele.
He aha ka ʻōlelo a ke kumu no ka hā?
Ua ʻōlelo ʻo ia, "ʻO ka hā ke ola."
He aha kā Kahekili i hoʻohiki ai?
Ua hoʻohiki ʻo ia e hoʻokani i ka ipu me ka lōkahi.

lessons.title: Ka loko iʻa o nā menehune
lessons.summary: Kanoelani, whose family comes from Kauaʻi, visits an old fishpond near Līhuʻe with an archaeologist, who tells her the legend that the Menehune built its wall in one night.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kanoelani ma Seattle, akā no Kauaʻi kona ʻohana. He mamo ʻo ia o kekahi ʻohana kahiko o Kauaʻi. I kēia kauwela, ua hele ʻo ia i Kauaʻi no ka hoʻomaha.

Ma Līhuʻe, ua hālāwai ʻo ia me kekahi mea hulikoehana, ʻo Kaluhiwa. He kēkelē laeoʻo ko Kaluhiwa ma ka hulikoehana, a he laeoʻo ʻo ia no nā wahi kahiko o Kauaʻi.

Ua hele lāua i kekahi loko iʻa kahiko kokoke i Līhuʻe. "Na nā menehune i kūkulu i kēia loko iʻa," wahi a Kaluhiwa. Ua ʻakaʻaka ʻo Kanoelani. "Nā menehune? Nā kānaka liʻiliʻi o ka moʻolelo?" Ua ʻakaʻaka pū ka mea hulikoehana. "ʻAe. Wahi a ka moʻolelo, ua hana nā menehune i ka pō hoʻokahi wale nō. Ua halihali lākou i nā pōhaku mai kahi mamao, mai kekahi lima a i kekahi lima. I ke kakahiaka, ua pau ka hana."

Ua hoʻopuni ʻia ka loko iʻa e kekahi pā pōhaku lōʻihi. Ma waho o ka pā, aia ka muliwai. Ma kekahi puka liʻiliʻi o ka pā, kahe ka wai i loko, a kahe ka wai i waho. Ma loko o ka pā, mālie ka wai, a ola nā iʻa. "Ua halihali ʻia kēia mau pōhaku a pau e ka lima," wahi a Kaluhiwa.

"I kēia mau lā, kākaʻikahi nā loko iʻa kahiko e like me kēia," wahi āna. "Ua nalowale ka hapanui. He wahi laʻa kēia no ka poʻe Hawaiʻi. Mai hele ma luna o ka pā." Ua kū ʻo Kanoelani ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka wai, a ua noʻonoʻo ʻo ia i kona poʻe kūpuna. "He mamo au o kēia ʻāina laʻa," wahi āna.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka hana a Kaluhiwa?
He mea hulikoehana ʻo ia, he laeoʻo no nā wahi kahiko o Kauaʻi.
Na wai i kūkulu i ka loko iʻa, wahi a ka moʻolelo?
Na nā menehune i kūkulu i ka loko iʻa.
Pehea i halihali ai nā menehune i nā pōhaku?
Ua halihali lākou i nā pōhaku mai kekahi lima a i kekahi lima.
He aha ka mea e hoʻopuni ana i ka loko iʻa?
He pā pōhaku lōʻihi ka mea e hoʻopuni ana i ka loko iʻa.
He nui paha nā loko iʻa kahiko i kēia mau lā?
ʻAʻole, kākaʻikahi nā loko iʻa kahiko i kēia mau lā.

lessons.title: Ke kaʻa ma ka pali
lessons.summary: Back on Oʻahu for a holiday, Keaolani and Kimo leave a bag in their car at the Nuʻuanu lookout; a thief breaks the window and escapes, and the bank texts her about a purchase she never approved.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Keaolani lāua ʻo kāna kāne, ʻo Kimo, ma Las Vegas, akā ua hānau ʻia lāua ma Oʻahu. I kēia Kekemapa, ua hoʻi mai lāua i Oʻahu no ka hoʻomaha.

I ka lā mua, ua holo lāua ma ke kaʻa i ka pali o Nuʻuanu. Mai luna o ka pali, ua ʻike lāua i Kāneʻohe a me ke kai. Ua waiho lāua i ke kaʻa, a ua hele wāwae lāua i ka ʻaoʻao o ka pali. Ua waiho ʻo Keaolani i kāna ukana liʻiliʻi i loko o ke kaʻa. Ua hilinaʻi ʻo ia, ʻaʻohe ʻaihue ma laila i ke ao.

Ma hope o 15 minuke, ua hoʻi lāua i ke kaʻa. Ua wāwahi ʻia ka puka aniani o ke kaʻa! Ua nalowale ka ukana o Keaolani. "He pōpilikia kēia!" wahi a Kimo. Ua kāhea koke ʻo Keaolani i nā mākaʻi ma ke kelepona.

Ma hope o 20 minuke, ua hōʻea mai kekahi mākaʻi. "Wāwahi pinepine nā ʻaihue i nā kaʻa ma ʻaneʻi," wahi a ka mākaʻi. "Hele mai lākou, wāwahi lākou i ke aniani, a pakele koke lākou. Ua pakele kēia ʻaihue ma mua o ka hōʻea ʻana mai o nā mākaʻi. Mai hilinaʻi i ke kaʻa no nā mea waiwai."

Aia ka kāleka panakō o Keaolani i loko o ka ukana. Ua kāhea ʻo ia i ka panakō. Ma hope o kekahi mau minuke, ua loaʻa iā ia kekahi kikokikona mai ka panakō: "Ua makemake kekahi e kūʻai i kekahi kamepiula me kāu kāleka. Ua ʻāpono ʻoe i kēia kūʻai ʻana?" Ua pane ʻo ia ma ke kikokikona: "ʻAʻole! ʻAʻole au i ʻāpono!" ʻAʻole i ʻāpono ka panakō i ke kūʻai ʻana.

He lā pōpilikia kēlā, akā ʻaʻole i nalowale ke kālā. "ʻAʻole au e hilinaʻi hou i ke kaʻa," wahi a Keaolani.

Nā nīnau:
Ua waiho ʻo Keaolani i kāna ukana i loko o ke aha?
Ua waiho ʻo ia i kāna ukana i loko o ke kaʻa.
He aha ka mea i hana ʻia i ke kaʻa?
Ua wāwahi ʻia ka puka aniani o ke kaʻa.
Ua kāhea ʻo Keaolani iā wai?
Ua kāhea ʻo ia i nā mākaʻi a me ka panakō.
He aha ka nīnau o ka panakō ma ke kikokikona?
Ua nīnau ka panakō inā ua ʻāpono ʻo ia i ke kūʻai ʻana.

lessons.title: Ka waʻa ma Kailua
lessons.summary: On a holiday, Kanakoa and his father go out on a small sailing canoe off Kailua; the steerswoman gives them oil against the sun, Kanakoa feels seasick, and she holds the canoe back in a strong wind.
lessons.text:
I kekahi lā hoʻomaha, ua hele ʻo Kanakoa me kona makuakāne i ke kahakai ma Kailua. E holo ana lāua ma kekahi waʻa no ka manawa mua. ʻO Kekaulike ka mea hoʻokele o ka waʻa.

He waʻa liʻiliʻi a māmā ia. "Māmā kēia waʻa, a holo wikiwiki ia ma ke kai," wahi a Kekaulike. He ʻelua keʻa ma luna o ka waʻa, a ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā keʻa me nā kaula. Aia kekahi kia lōʻihi ma waena o ka waʻa, a ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka peʻa ma ke kia.

Ma mua o ka holo ʻana, ua hāʻawi ʻo Kekaulike i kekahi ʻaila iā lāua. "Wela loa ka lā ma ke kai," wahi āna. Ua hoʻokomo lāua i ka ʻaila ma ko lāua mau lima a me ko lāua alo.

A laila, ua kele ka waʻa mai ke kahakai a i kekahi mokupuni liʻiliʻi. Ua noho ʻo Kekaulike ma hope o ka waʻa, a ua hoʻokele ʻo ia. Ua huki ka makuakāne i ke kaula o ka peʻa. "ʻAʻole wau i maʻa i ke kai," wahi āna. "Maʻa wau i ke kaʻa wale nō."

Ma hope o kekahi manawa, ua nui nā nalu, a ua ʻeha ka naʻau o Kanakoa. "E huli i kou alo i ka ʻāina, a e nānā i nā mauna," wahi a Kekaulike. Ua nānā ʻo ia i nā mauna, a ua maikaʻi iki kona naʻau.

Ua ikaika loa ka makani. Ua kāohi ʻo Kekaulike i ka waʻa, a ua hoʻēmi ʻo ia i ka peʻa. "Pono kākou e kāohi i ka waʻa i ka makani ikaika," wahi āna. Ua kele mālie lākou a hiki i ke kahakai.

Ma laila, ua hoʻomaʻemaʻe lākou i ka waʻa me ka wai. Ua hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻo Kanakoa i nā keʻa a me ke kia. "Ua maʻa iki au i ke kai i kēia lā!" wahi a kona makuakāne.

Nā nīnau:
ʻO wai ka mea hoʻokele o ka waʻa?
ʻO Kekaulike ka mea hoʻokele o ka waʻa.
No ke aha lāua i hoʻokomo ai i ka ʻaila?
No ka mea, wela loa ka lā ma ke kai.
Ua ʻeha ka naʻau o wai?
Ua ʻeha ka naʻau o Kanakoa.
He aha kā lākou i hana ai ma ke kahakai ma hope?
Ua hoʻomaʻemaʻe lākou i ka waʻa me ka wai.

lessons.title: Ka hale aliʻi ʻo ʻIolani
lessons.summary: Mokihana, a student from California on holiday in Honolulu, tours ʻIolani Palace; the guide's talk covers the missionaries, the palace servants, the 1895 uprising, the queen's imprisonment and the Territory.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Mokihana ma Kaleponi. Ua hele ʻo ia i Honolulu no ka hoʻomaha, a ua kipa ʻo ia i ka hale aliʻi ʻo ʻIolani.

Ma kūwaho o ka hale aliʻi, ua hāʻawi ke alakaʻi, ʻo Leiana, i kekahi haʻiʻōlelo pōkole. "Ua kūkulu ʻia kēia hale e ka Mōʻī Kalākaua i ka makahiki 1882," wahi āna. "Nani ka ʻaoʻao kūwaho o ka hale."

"I ka makahiki 1820, ua hōʻea mai nā mikanele mua mai ʻAmelika. Ua hoʻokahua nā mikanele i nā kula a me nā hale pule. Ua unuhi lākou i ka Palapala Hemolele i ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi, a ua paʻi ʻia ka Palapala Hemolele Hawaiʻi i ka makahiki 1839."

Ma lalo o ka hale aliʻi, aia nā lumi o nā kauā. "Ua hana nā kauā no ka mōʻī a me kona ʻohana," wahi a Leiana.

"I ka makahiki 1893, ua hoʻokahuli kekahi poʻe kālepa haole i ke aupuni o ka mōʻī wahine, ʻo Liliʻuokalani. I ka makahiki 1895, ua kipi kekahi poʻe Hawaiʻi i ke aupuni hou. ʻAʻole i lanakila ke kipi. Ua hoʻohewa ʻia ka mōʻī wahine, a ua paʻa ʻo ia ma kekahi lumi o kēia hale no ʻewalu mahina. Ua kipaku ʻia kekahi o ka poʻe kipi mai Hawaiʻi aku."

"Mai ka makahiki 1900 a hiki i ka makahiki 1959, he kelikoli ʻo Hawaiʻi, ʻo ke Kelikoli o Hawaiʻi. Ma ia wā, ua hoʻokae kekahi poʻe i ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi ma nā kula. I kēia mau lā, ʻaʻole hoʻokae ʻia ka ʻōlelo, a aʻo ʻia ma nā kula kaiapuni."

Ma hope o ka haʻiʻōlelo, ua kū ʻo Mokihana ma kūwaho o ka hale aliʻi. "Ua aʻo au i ka mōʻaukala ma ke kula, akā he ʻokoʻa ke kū ʻana ma ʻaneʻi," wahi āna.

Nā nīnau:
Na wai i kūkulu i ka hale aliʻi ʻo ʻIolani?
Ua kūkulu ʻia ka hale e ka Mōʻī Kalākaua i ka makahiki 1882.
He aha ka mea a nā mikanele i hoʻokahua ai?
Ua hoʻokahua lākou i nā kula a me nā hale pule.
He aha ka mea i hana ʻia i ka mōʻī wahine ma hope o ke kipi?
Ua hoʻohewa ʻia ʻo ia, a ua paʻa ʻo ia ma kekahi lumi o ka hale aliʻi.
He aha ka mea i hana ʻia i kekahi o ka poʻe kipi?
Ua kipaku ʻia lākou mai Hawaiʻi aku.

lessons.title: Ka mahi kope ma Kaʻū
lessons.summary: Kahurangi from Aotearoa volunteers for three weeks on Kawelo's coffee farm in Kaʻū: she picks coffee cherries and eggs, cuts old branches, hears that the land once grew tobacco, and leaves with a kukui lei.
lessons.text:
Noho ʻo Kahurangi ma Aotearoa. He 22 makahiki ʻo ia. Ua loaʻa iā ia kekahi hana manawaleʻa ma kekahi mahi kope ma Kaʻū no ʻekolu pule. ʻAʻohe uku no ka hana manawaleʻa, akā loaʻa iā ia kahi e noho ai a me ka ʻai.

Na Kawelo ka mahi. He 68 makahiki ʻo ia, a paʻahana loa ʻo ia. "Momona ka lepo ma ʻaneʻi," wahi āna, "no ka mea, no ka pele ka lepo. Ulu maikaʻi ke kope ma ka lepo momona."

I ka lā mua, ua ʻohi ʻo Kahurangi i nā hua kope ʻulaʻula. "Mai ʻohi i nā hua ʻōmaʻomaʻo," wahi a Kawelo. I ka lā aʻe, ua ʻoki lāua i nā lālā kahiko o nā lāʻau kope. "Inā ʻoki ʻoe i nā lālā kahiko, ulu mai nā lālā hou," wahi a Kawelo.

Holo nā moa ma nā wahi a pau o ka mahi. I kēlā me kēia kakahiaka, ua hānai ʻo Kahurangi i nā moa, a ua ʻohi ʻo ia i nā hua moa.

Aia kekahi mau lāʻau kukui ma ka palena o ka mahi. "Ua kanu koʻu kupuna kāne i kēia mau kukui, a me ka paka," wahi a Kawelo. "He paka ma mua, he kope i kēia manawa." Ua ʻohi lāua i nā hua kukui, a ua hana ʻo Kawelo i kekahi lei kukui no Kahurangi.

I ka pō, ua kaʻana ʻo Kawelo i kāna ʻai me Kahurangi. "Kaʻana mākou i nā mea a pau ma ʻaneʻi," wahi āna. "Ua paʻahana au i koʻu wā uʻi, a paʻahana nō au i kēia manawa. ʻAʻole au he uʻi hou, akā ikaika nō koʻu mau lima!"

Ma hope o ʻekolu pule, ua haʻalele ʻo Kahurangi i ka mahi me ka lei kukui. "Mahalo nui. He kanaka manawaleʻa ʻoe," wahi āna.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka hana a Kahurangi ma Kaʻū?
He hana manawaleʻa kāna ma kekahi mahi kope.
No ke aha i momona ai ka lepo, wahi a Kawelo?
No ka mea, no ka pele ka lepo.
He aha nā hua a Kahurangi i ʻohi ai?
Ua ʻohi ʻo ia i nā hua kope ʻulaʻula a me nā hua moa.
He aha ka mea a Kawelo i hana ai no Kahurangi?
Ua hana ʻo ia i kekahi lei kukui no Kahurangi.

lessons.title: Ka huakaʻi i Iāpana
lessons.summary: Engineers Kaʻōnaona and Kaleohano in Kahului want two weeks in Japan; they analyse every cost, add up a total that keeps rising, decide not to touch their invested savings, and save at the bank for a year.
lessons.text:
He ʻenekinia ʻo Kaʻōnaona ma Kahului, ma ka mokupuni ʻo Maui. He ʻenekinia pū kāna kāne, ʻo Kaleohano. Makemake lāua e hele i Iāpana no ʻelua pule.

Ma mua o ka huakaʻi, ua kālailai lāua i ke kumukūʻai. Ua kālailai ʻo Kaʻōnaona i kēlā me kēia mea, e like me kāna hana ma ka ʻoihana: nā mokulele, kahi e moe ai, ka ʻai, a me nā kaʻaahi ma Iāpana.

A laila, ua pākuʻi ʻo ia i nā kumukūʻai a pau. Ua nīnau ʻo Kaleohano, "He aha ka huina?" "He 9,000 kālā ka huina," wahi a Kaʻōnaona. "Nui loa kēlā!" Ua pākuʻi ʻo Kaleohano i ke kumukūʻai o nā makana no ko lāua ʻohana, a ua piʻi hou ka huina.

Aia kekahi o kā lāua kālā ma ka panakō, akā ua hoʻopukapuka lāua i ka hapanui o kā lāua kālā. "ʻAʻole kāua e lawe i ke kālā i hoʻopukapuka ʻia," wahi a Kaleohano. "No nā makahiki e hiki mai ana ia kālā."

I kekahi pō, ua hoʻi maila ʻo Kaleohano mai kāna hana me kekahi nūpepa. Ua heluhelu ʻo ia: i kēlā me kēia makahiki, hoʻolilo nā malihini ma kahi o iwakālua piliona kālā ma Hawaiʻi. "He mau piliona kālā! A he 9,000 kālā wale nō kā kāua huakaʻi!" wahi āna, a ua ʻakaʻaka lāua.

"ʻO Iāpana ka ʻāina aʻu i makemake ai e ʻike no nā makahiki he nui," wahi a Kaʻōnaona. Ua hoʻoholo lāua e hoʻokomo i 600 kālā i kēlā me kēia mahina ma ka panakō. Ua kelepona maila kona makuahine, a ua haʻi ʻo Kaʻōnaona iā ia no ka huakaʻi.

Ma hope o hoʻokahi makahiki, ua hele lāua i Iāpana, a ua holo lāua ma nā kaʻaahi wikiwiki. "ʻO kēia ka huakaʻi aʻu i noʻonoʻo ai i kēlā me kēia lā," wahi a Kaʻōnaona.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka hana a Kaʻōnaona lāua ʻo Kaleohano?
He ʻenekinia lāua ʻelua.
He aha ka huina mua o nā kumukūʻai?
He 9,000 kālā ka huina mua.
No ke aha ʻaʻole lāua i lawe i ke kālā i hoʻopukapuka ʻia?
No ka mea, no nā makahiki e hiki mai ana ia kālā.
He aha ka mea a lāua i hana ai no ka huakaʻi?
Ua hoʻokomo lāua i 600 kālā i kēlā me kēia mahina ma ka panakō.

lessons.title: Ka hui pōpō pekenekene
lessons.summary: Kana, captain of a Kāneʻohe high-school volleyball team, flies with her team to a tournament in California: video games on the plane, nicknames on the shirts, a teammate taken to hospital, and a Hawaiian pitcher at a baseball game.
lessons.text:
ʻO Kanaʻiaupuni ke alakaʻi o ka hui pōpō pekenekene o kona kula kiʻekiʻe ma Kāneʻohe. He 17 makahiki ʻo ia. ʻO Kana kona inoa kapakapa. Kapa nā hoa a pau iā ia ʻo Kana, no ka mea, lōʻihi loa kona inoa maoli.

I kēia makahiki, e hele ana ka hui i Kaleponi no kekahi hoʻokūkū pōpō pekenekene. Ma ka mokulele, ua pāʻani nā kaikamāhine i nā keluaka wikiō ma ko lākou kelepona. Ua pāʻani ʻo Kana i kekahi keluaka wikiō no ka pōpō pekenekene.

Ma Kaleponi, ua hāʻawi ke kumu i nā lole hou i nā kaikamāhine. Ua paʻi ʻia nā inoa kapakapa ma nā lole. He ʻehā huapalapala o ka inoa ʻo Kana, a ʻelua o lākou he woela. "He ʻelima woela o ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi," wahi a ke kumu. "Aia nā woela ma nā huaʻōlelo Hawaiʻi a pau."

Nui nā ukali o ka hui ma ka pūnaewele. Nānā lākou i nā kiʻi a me nā wikiō o kēlā me kēia pāʻani. Ua ukali pū kekahi mau mākua i ka hui i Kaleponi.

Ma ka pāʻani ʻelua, ua hāʻule kekahi o nā kaikamāhine, ʻo Kaʻilinoe, a ua ʻeha kona wāwae. Ua lawe ʻia ʻo ia i ka haukapila. "ʻAʻole pilikia nui kēia," wahi a ke kauka ma ka haukapila. "Pono ʻoe e hoʻomaha no ʻekolu lā." Ua hoʻi ʻo Kaʻilinoe mai ka haukapila, a ua nānā ʻo ia i nā pāʻani a pau me kona mau hoa.

I ka pō hope, ua hele ka hui i kekahi pāʻani kinipōpō. He mea pekuniho mai Hawaiʻi ma kekahi o nā kime. Ua pekuniho ʻo ia i ka pōpō me ka wikiwiki loa. "He mea pekuniho kaulana ʻo ia!" wahi a Kana. Ua lilo nā kaikamāhine i ukali nona ma ka pūnaewele.

Nā nīnau:
He aha ka inoa kapakapa o Kanaʻiaupuni?
ʻO Kana kona inoa kapakapa.
He aha ka mea a nā kaikamāhine i pāʻani ai ma ka mokulele?
Ua pāʻani lākou i nā keluaka wikiō ma ko lākou kelepona.
ʻEhia huapalapala o ka inoa ʻo Kana?
He ʻehā huapalapala o ka inoa ʻo Kana, a he ʻelua woela.
No ke aha i hele ai ʻo Kaʻilinoe i ka haukapila?
No ka mea, ua hāʻule ʻo ia, a ua ʻeha kona wāwae.
